subject: a tall stack of three thick, fluffy buttermilk pancakes with a square pat of butter on top and warm maple syrup poured over, running down the sides

geometry.silhouette: 3단 두툼 스택(약 2.5cm/장), 돔 윗면, 부푼 둥근 가장자리, 손으로 놓은 오프셋, 높이≈폭의 60%, 프레임 폭 65% 점유. 토핑은 전부 윗면에 얹힘(반죽에 박지 않음).
geometry.body: Three thick, tender pancakes stacked with a small, casual offset, as if placed by hand rather than aligned by a machine — the middle one shifted a little to the right, the top one a little back. Each pancake is a plump, pillowy round about 2.5 cm thick with a gently domed top and a soft rounded edge that bulges slightly outward where the batter rose in the pan; the stack is about 60% as tall as it is wide and occupies roughly 65% of the frame width, leaving generous empty background around it. The top face of each pancake is griddle-browned in a soft, blotchy, uneven gradient — warm caramel brown (#B9793F) at the centre where it sat longest on the hot pan, fading through toasty golden (#CF9455) into light golden (#D9A76B) toward the rim, with a few slightly darker freckles and one paler patch where a bubble lifted the batter, the way real pancakes never brown evenly. The side wall of every pancake is the pale cream of the risen crumb (#F1DDB0): a soft, spongy band with a fine open crumb texture, tiny irregular air pockets catching the light, meeting the browned top in a soft blurred edge rather than a hard line. A few tiny pinprick pores sit near the rim of the top pancake, barely visible. Where the pancakes touch, the top one presses very slightly into the one below, so the edges kiss softly instead of floating. The whole stack looks warm, tender and freshly flipped — the honest irregularity of a handmade bake.

toppings.label: BUTTER
toppings.text: One square pat of butter, about 2 cm across with slightly uneven cut edges, sits just off-centre on the top pancake. It is still a solid, recognisable square — pale yellow (#F3DDA0) with a faint sheen where the light lands — but it has been there for half a minute: its corners have softened, its bottom edge has begun to melt into a small glossy golden pool (#E8C170) that soaks a darker ring into the crumb around it, and one side is slumping very slightly toward the syrup.

toppings.label: SYRUP
toppings.text: Warm maple syrup (#A85A1A), translucent amber and slow, has been poured generously over the stack from above: it sheets across the top face, gathers in the shallow dip around the butter, spills over the edge at two places and runs down the side walls in several drips of different lengths and widths — one broad drip reaching the bottom pancake and rounding into a soft bead, a couple of thinner ones stopping on the middle layer, one just starting. Where the syrup runs over the pale cream side walls it turns them a darker, glossy soaked gold and catches a bright highlight along every drip; a few tiny bubbles are trapped in the thickest pool, and a thin line of syrup has seeped into the seam between the top two pancakes.

toppings.label: FINISHING
toppings.text: A barely-there dusting of powdered sugar over the rim of the top pancake away from the syrup, settling into the little browning freckles and dissolving into faint translucent specks where it meets the syrup. Nothing else on top — the classic stack, generous and simple. The pour lands toward the front-left so the beautifully browned surface stays visible on the far side, and everything reads as one deliberate, appetizing plate: realistic portion size, no duplicate identical elements.

materials_lighting: Premium food-icon look: slightly simplified, clean forms with believable, appetizing materials — matte tender pancake crumb with a faint velvety sheen only where it browned, a solid butter pat just starting to gleam at its melting base, and translucent, glossy syrup with bright soft highlights. Soft studio softbox key light from the upper left with gentle warm ambient fill, a subtle rim of light along the top edges of the stack, and a faint, soft contact shadow directly beneath the stack only. Appetizing food-photography color grading: warm, fresh, clean whites, saturated but natural colours, no colour cast on the background. Shot as if with an 85 mm lens at a comfortable distance, everything in crisp focus.
camera: Three-quarter top-front view, the dessert centered with generous margin on all sides.
background: Background: seamless solid pale sage (#DFEAE0), flat and even.
mood: a warm weekend-morning breakfast stack, syrup still moving, that makes you want to pick up a fork.
